decision.title: fn:transform (packet )
decision.summary: fn:transform is the optional feature "xslt-transform", whose resumable body compiles the stylesheet, primes the transformation and asks the machine for a , with no evaluator nested in C.

body.p: , after , , , , , , , . Replaces 's place for fn:transform (the function was absent, XPST0017; supports-dynamic-xslt false).

item.p: Optional feature: sxml_xslt_transform_feature() ("xslt-transform", declared in include/sxml/xslt.h as the packet's option 2), whose library_functions hold the one row (); in sxml_all_optional_features(). A host that names no XSLT and not the feature links no XSLT; sxml-full.wasm links it ().

One mechanism (): the row's resumable body (src/xslt_transform_function.c, golden file src/xquery_load_module.c) reads the 33 options of F&O 4.0, 18.3 (the option limit of the option conventions is 40 now), compiles the stylesheet with xslt.h's compiler, primes the transformation and asks the machine for EVALUATE_UNIT; the next step delivers the principal result and collects the result documents (the built-in collector) into the result map; one step per result runs post-process. src/xslt.c splits sxml_xslt_stylesheet_transform into prime, describe, run and deliver, so a machine transformation (src/xslt_transform_internal.h) is the same priming with the evaluation left to the machine. No evaluator runs nested in C (); compiling evaluates static expressions on an evaluator of their own, where fn:transform has no evaluation environment and raises FOXT0004, so the compiler is not re-entered.

Extension per unit evaluation: sxml_evaluation_request.extension is kept in the unit's global table (a unit evaluation that gives none, such as xsl:evaluate's, inherits the asking code's); sxml_dynamic_context_get_unit_extension gives the running code's. The result writer is found there first, so xsl:result-document and current-output-uri of the inner transformation reach its own writer; xsl:message honours enable-messages false. The body drops the extension before it releases the transformation, so function items that outlive it (transform-003) see none.

Options: exactly one of stylesheet-location/-node/-text, package-location/-node/-text and package-name (FOXT0002); a node is serialized and compiled as text with its base URI (or stylesheet-base-uri); a location is read as fn:doc reads it (the caller's trust and documents; FOXT0002 when it cannot be read); a package name is a RESOLVED_PACKAGE. The invocation is the first of initial-function (with function-params), initial-template, a source (source-node, source-location, initial-match-selection; at most one), else xsl:initial-template; initial-mode with a call is FOXT0002, xsl:unnamed selects the unnamed mode. The global context item is global-context-item, else the root of source-node, else the source-location document. Parameter maps need xs:QName keys (XPTY0004). delivery-format document is TREE, absent is DEFAULT (build-tree), raw, serialized (UTF-8, no byte order mark, as fn:serialize), file FOXT0004, others FOXT0002. serialization-params override the unnamed xsl:output, the list parameters joined. xslt-version above 4.0 and requested-properties that the XSLT system property table does not give (xsl:version ignored) are FOXT0001. trusted false (the default) makes the unit untrusted. A stylesheet that is not well-formed is FOXT0003; static and type errors keep their codes as dynamic errors.

Result map: "output" or the base output URI, resolved, for the principal result (left out when it is empty beside result documents, unless a result document became it, 26.2.2); each result document by its absolute URI.
Drivers: QT4 supports fn-transform-XSLT and fn-transform-XSLT30 (a 4.0 processor serves 3.0) and serves XSLT_MODULE as suite files; fn-transform is no non-goal set any more.

Counts (release drivers): QT4 fn-transform XQ40 0 to 129 of the 133 run (137, 4 not run), XP40 126 of 130; gate 80 % met. XT40 8,861 to 8,870 passed, none lost, 0 errors; transform 0 to 9 of 12 (transform-009 now reaches an assertion the driver does not check).
Size: sxml.wasm 2,119,912 to 2,120,239 (+327, the extension lookups); sxml-full.wasm 2,224,369 to 3,554,353 (+1,329,984, XSLT).

Not done: fn:transform in a static expression (transform-004: static evaluation has no evaluation environment); enable-assertions false (assertions stay enabled, fn-transform-91); a separate execution scope (cache false still shares current-dateTime, fn-transform-27); the inner transformation shares the caller's document loader (fn:doc is not stripped as its xsl:strip-space asks), available documents and trace sink, and fn:function-lookup sees the caller's table; xslt-version 2.0 behaviour (82e); the QT4 driver gives a query file no base URI of its own (fn-transform-94); ~record patterns (transform-401, XSLT).
